mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, ticket_id, quantity, price, discount_rate, discount_amount, final_amount, order_status, ordered_at, canceled_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{ticketId}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderedAt}, #{canceledAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, ticket_id, quantity, price, discount_rate, discount_amount, final_amount, order_status, ordered_at, canceled_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY order_id DESC

SELECT order_id, user_id, ticket_id, quantity, price, discount_rate, discount_amount, final_amount, order_status, ordered_at, canceled_at FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId}
